title: V4 Question Types Demo B
description: One question of each of five more V4 types: dimensional analysis, nuclear notation, predicting products, molecular shape, and completing a table.

questions.text: How many moles of sodium chloride are in 117 g of NaCl? (Molar mass 58.5 g/mol.)
questions.explanation: Multiply by 1 mol / 58.5 g so the grams cancel: 117 g x (1 mol / 58.5 g) = 2 mol.

questions.text: Complete the alpha decay of uranium-238.
questions.explanation: An alpha particle carries away 4 mass units and 2 protons, leaving thorium-234 (Z = 90).

questions.text: Predict the products of this double-displacement reaction.
questions.explanation: Silver chloride is insoluble, so it precipitates; sodium nitrate stays dissolved.

questions.text: Describe the shape of the ammonia molecule.
questions.explanation: Four electron groups (three bonds, one lone pair) give a tetrahedral arrangement and a trigonal pyramidal shape.

questions.text: Complete the table of subatomic particles.
questions.explanation: Neutrons = mass number - protons; an anion has more electrons than protons.
